title: The Eight-Second Gap: How Long Does a Neutron Live
summary: A translation of the same day's science episode: the two ways of measuring a free neutron's mean lifetime — holding them in a bottle and counting the survivors, versus counting the protons born inside a beam — disagree by about eight seconds, and the gap is larger than the stated errors. It covers the proposed dark decay channel, how the lifetime fixed the helium made in the Big Bang, and why J-PARC's third method has not closed the case.
